sentences.text: To plot a position, start with the latitude.
Find forty-one degrees, eighteen and a half minutes on the side scale, and lay a straightedge or one arm of your parallel rulers horizontally across the chart at that latitude.
Next, find seventy-one degrees, thirty-five minutes on the top scale, set your dividers from the nearest meridian to that longitude, and carry that distance along your straightedge.
Mark the spot with a sharp dot, circle it if it’s a fix, and write the time beside it.
